players.product: AI colocation in retrofit data centers (NC-1 North Carolina 40 MW IT leased to Nscale; MTL-3 Montreal for Cerebras) plus GPU cloud services on NVIDIA B300 / Vera Rubin clusters

quarterly_data.signal: WhiteFiber's September 2026 investor presentation (company information as of August 31, 2026; gross MW): more than $550M of cloud total contract value won since May 2026 (Paris region, Hyperbolic / Modal Labs, Prime Intellect, an AI inference platform, and new service orders with an existing and a new customer, including an approximately $16 million July 2026 contract win); 7,500+ NVIDIA GPUs contracted and 20+ customers; ~11 MW online in 2025 and ~70 MW online by YE 2026E with a ~1.5 GW pipeline; NC-1 initial deployment and billing commenced in Q3 2026. LTM Q2 2026 revenue was $94.5M (data center $15.0M, cloud services including equipment leasing $79.5M).
quarterly_data.figure: >$550M cloud TCV since May 2026; 7,500+ NVIDIA GPUs contracted; ~70 MW online by YE 2026E
